course.title: Unit 5 What a Delicious Meal!【例句】

sentences.content: How do we make mashed potatoes?
sentences.english: How do we make mashed potatoes ?

sentences.content: First, wash the potatoes.
sentences.english: First , wash the potatoes

sentences.content: What do we do after that?
sentences.english: What do we do after that ?

sentences.content: Then, cut them into pieces.
sentences.english: Then , cut them into pieces

sentences.content: Next, put the potatoes in a pot and boil them until they are soft.
sentences.english: Next , put the potatoes in a pot and boil them until they are soft
sentences.chinese: 接下来，将土豆放入锅中煮至软烂。

wordDetails.definition: 短语动词原型: 放置

sentences.content: Then, mash the potatoes.
sentences.english: Then , mash the potatoes

sentences.content: After that, add the milk and butter to the potatoes, and mix.
sentences.english: After that , add the milk and butter to the potatoes , and mix
sentences.chinese: 之后，将牛奶和黄油加入土豆中，搅拌均匀。

sentences.content: Finally, add salt and pepper.
sentences.english: Finally , add salt and pepper

sentences.content: How do we make stir-fried eggs and tomatoes?
sentences.english: How do we make stir-fried eggs and tomatoes ?

sentences.content: First, cut the tomatoes into small pieces.
sentences.english: First , cut the tomatoes into small pieces
sentences.chinese: 首先，将西红柿切成小块。

sentences.content: Next, mix the eggs in a bowl.
sentences.english: Next , mix the eggs in a bowl
sentences.chinese: 接下来，将鸡蛋在碗中搅拌均匀。

sentences.content: Then, heat some oil in a pan and add the eggs to it.
sentences.english: Then , heat some oil in a pan and add the eggs to it
sentences.chinese: 然后，在平底锅中加热一些油，将鸡蛋倒入其中。

sentences.content: Stir-fry for one minute and then take the eggs out of the pan.
sentences.english: Stir-fry for one minute and then take the eggs out of the pan
sentences.chinese: 翻炒一分钟，然后将鸡蛋从锅中取出。

sentences.content: Next, cook the tomatoes in the pan until they’re soft.
sentences.english: Next , cook the tomatoes in the pan until they're soft
sentences.chinese: 接下来，将番茄放入锅中烹煮至变软。

sentences.content: Then, add some salt and sugar.
sentences.english: Then , add some salt and sugar

sentences.content: Finally, put the eggs back into the pan and mix them with the tomatoes.
sentences.english: Finally , put the eggs back into the pan and mix them with the tomatoes
sentences.chinese: 最后，将鸡蛋重新放回锅中，与西红柿一起翻炒均匀。

sentences.content: What an amazing smell!
sentences.english: What an amazing smell !

sentences.content: How delicious the dish looks!
sentences.english: How delicious the dish looks !
